title: Lawn Mower Cover 600D Oxford – with Drawstring
descriptionHtml:
Your lawn mower cost thousands. The rain doesn't care.

Sun bleaches the paint, rain rusts the blades and leaves collect in the engine. An unprotected mower ages twice as fast – entirely needlessly.

The solution: pull over, pull tight – done

A durable cover in 600D Oxford – the same hard-wearing material as our seat covers – with a drawstring that gives a snug fit around the machine. Dry, clean and ready when you are.

Features

  • Protects against rain, UV, dust and leaves
  • Fits snugly around the machine – drawstring at the hem
  • Withstands weather all year round – heavy-duty 600D Oxford fabric
  • Fits most mowers – including ride-on mowers
  • Discreet black for outdoor storage
